clips.line: I recently visited WET’s headquarters in Burbank, California,
clips.note: A Bloomberg reporter visits WET, the company that makes huge fountains. Its headquarters (main office) is in Burbank, California.
clips.noteUa: Репортер Bloomberg приїжджає в компанію WET, яка робить величезні фонтани. Її головний офіс — у Бербанку, Каліфорнія.
around: partly to find out how Mark turned fountains into hi-tech performance art, but mostly so that I could do this.

clips.line: And from its headquarters in Mount Forest, Ontario, it’s set itself the goal of making the world a better place.
clips.note: A film about a company that makes waste bins. Its North American headquarters is in Mount Forest, Ontario.
clips.noteUa: Фільм про компанію, яка робить контейнери для сміття. Її головний офіс у Північній Америці — у Маунт-Форест, Онтаріо.
around: In 1999 the brand crossed the Atlantic and established Molok North America.

clips.line: and our headquarters here in San Francisco.
clips.note: At a GitHub event, a worker lists the company’s offices around the world, and its headquarters here in San Francisco.
clips.noteUa: На заході GitHub працівниця перелічує офіси компанії по всьому світу та її головний офіс — тут, у Сан-Франциско.
around: to co-working spaces in burgeoning cities like Atlanta and New York, to our offices in Boulder, Amsterdam, and Tokyo,

clips.line: I packed up my equipment and headed to Kwamalasamutu, our headquarters in the northeast Amazon.
clips.note: A scientist who studies rainforest plants travels to a village in the Amazon. It is their headquarters (main base).
clips.noteUa: Науковець, який вивчає рослини тропічного лісу, вирушає в село в Амазонії. Там їхній головний осередок.
around: I took out my computer and gave my TED talk in the local language to the shamans and apprentices you see here.

clips.line: I think the second impression that I had, when you go into the Google headquarters…
clips.note: An older investor speaks at Google. His impression when you go into the Google headquarters: a huge map of the world with lights.
clips.noteUa: Літній інвестор виступає в Google. Його враження, коли заходиш у головний офіс Google: величезна мапа світу з вогниками.
around: So the first impression is, my God, what a different world this was from the world that I grew up in.
there’s this huge map of the world with light,

clips.line: And the Klan split into two groups in 1925 — the Ku Klux Klan, which moved its headquarters to Canon City, and the Minutemen of Colorado,
clips.note: A history film about Colorado in the 1920s. The Ku Klux Klan moved its headquarters (main office) to Cañon City.
clips.noteUa: Історичний фільм про Колорадо 1920-х. Ку-клукс-клан переніс свій головний офіс у Каньйон-Сіті.
around: which was a nativist, white nationalist group run by John Galen Locke.

clips.line: Um, it moved its headquarters a couple of years ago to Salem, and now it is, um, diversifying even more,
clips.note: A professor talks about a research group she belongs to. It started in Santa Rosa, and a couple of years ago it moved its headquarters to Salem.
clips.noteUa: Професорка розповідає про дослідницьку групу, до якої належить. Група почалася в Санта-Розі, а кілька років тому перенесла головний офіс у Сейлем.
around: It ended up in Santa Rosa, and we still meet in Santa Rosa, actually.

clips.line: The private company moved its headquarters to Norwalk, Connecticut, in 1973, and in Stamford, Connecticut, in 2000.
clips.note: A news report about Purdue, the company that made OxyContin. It moved its headquarters to Norwalk in 1973 and to Stamford in 2000.
clips.noteUa: Новинний сюжет про Purdue, компанію, що випускала оксиконтин. Вона перенесла головний офіс у Норвок у 1973 році, а в Стемфорд — у 2000-му.
around: Sixty years later, the company was bought by Raymond and Mortimer Sackler.
